messages.text:
"RITMO SELVAGEM – A Batalha Musical**.

### **🧟 Como funciona o jogo**

O jogador precisa derrotar hordas de zumbis e dinossauros usando instrumentos musicais.

**Instrumentos de ataque:**

- 🥁 Tambor
- 🎸 Guitarra
- 🎺 Trompete


- Compatível com celulares Android e iPhone.
- Controles por toque na tela.
- Sistema de ritmo e pontuação.
- Combos por acertos consecutivos.
- Zumbis e dinossauros como inimigos.
- Cinco vidas.
- Dificuldade progressiva.
- Efeitos visuais de ataque.


### **Como jogar**

. Aperte COMEÇAR SHOW.
. Toque no instrumento correspondente quando o monstro chegar à linha de ataque.


- Personagem principal personalizável.
- Chefões gigantes (T-Rex e zumbis mutantes).
- Músicas originais.
- Novos instrumentos e armas musicais.
- Fases em cidades infestadas.
- Loja para comprar instrumentos e melhorias.
- Gráficos 3D ou estilo desenho animado

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable rhythm-defense game based on “RITMO SELVAGEM – A Batalha Musical,” matching the requested theme, mechanics, and mobile-friendly controls.

## Requirements
- Create a game where the player defeats zombie and dinosaur enemies with drum, guitar, and trumpet attacks.
- Support Android/iPhone-style touch controls and keyboard fallback.
- Include rhythm timing, score, combos, five lives, progressive difficulty, start/pause flow, and visual attack effects.
- Make the game playable immediately in the browser without additional clarification or setup assumptions.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a single-page browser game using HTML/CSS/Canvas and JavaScript for instant playability.
- Assumed a stylized arcade presentation with a 3-lane combat rhythm system and local best-score persistence.
- Kept the scope to a complete playable prototype rather than a full multi-scene production build.

## Work State
### Completed
- A playable rhythm game shell was created with:
  - 3 instrument lanes: Tambor, Guitarra, Trompete
  - enemy waves, attack timing line, score, combo, lives, and difficulty scaling
  - start overlay and pause/restart flow
  - touch controls for mobile and key controls for desktop
  - local best-score tracking and sound cues
- Visual game scene and interface were implemented in a single HTML file for quick browser launch.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Open the game in a browser and verify the flow, timing feel, and controls.
2. If needed, tune enemy speed, hit windows, difficulty, and UI polish for better gameplay balance.
3. Confirm the start/pause/restart loop and touch interactions work on small screens.

## Relevant Files
- (none)

## Important Context
- The game is implemented in the current working directory as a single browser-based prototype; no additional build system or server setup was added.
- The core play loop and UI are intended to be immediately testable by opening the page in a browser.
